concepts.def: Used for categorical data; height shows frequency.
Uses symbols to represent counts; key gives the value of one symbol.
Circle divided into sectors representing each category's share; total = 360°.
Bars represent frequency density for continuous data; area = frequency.
Lists data and the frequency of each value or class.
Plots paired data; shows correlation (positive, negative, none).

walkthroughs.body_html:
Statistics & Probability — a core area of GCSE Maths.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Statistics & Probability brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Statistics & Probability.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
